{{Quote|As I was saying, heave to and prepare to be boarded.|Voyce Evlen|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Voyce Evlen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] whose [[Parent/Legends|mother]] was [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Biana Drayce]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she became [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] corvette ''[[Starhook]]''. She was sent by corrupt Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] to meet with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessel ''[[Concussor]]'', which, by then, was commandeered by [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s unit of [[Wraith Squadron]]. Evlen spoke with the fictitious Captain '''Avven Hocroft''', actually [[Wraith Two (callsign)|Wraith Two]] [[Turman Durra]] in disguise, who had previously transmitted a message asking Thaal whether he desired power. Seeing through Wraith Squadron's ruse, Evelen ordered her forces to open fire, but the Wraiths escaped.<ref name="MK" />
